entry.title: Standardizing an exposure classification for existing outputs (pre-BIP)
entry.summary: The recent update concerning the action keys listed in Appendix A appears to be derived from discussions held across two specific posts. These keys are critical from the perspective of wallet functionality, and their correctness is pivotal for the ongoing pull request noted at [GitHub PR](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2294). The decision to move forward with publication will hinge on the community feedback received via this pull request. It's essential for stakeholders to review these details promptly and provide input to ensure that any discrepancies are addressed effectively within the forum provided by the pull request. This step is crucial not only for validation from a technical standpoint but also for the broader acceptance and implementation within the system.
